changes.title: Pre-armor attack scaling
changes.text: Prepared player, enemy, boss and owned-summon attack scaling before armor; the pending damage controls remain disabled.

changes.title: Explicit offensive boundaries
changes.text: Prepared caster-based damage scaling with a neutral identity path and unchanged source objects for defenses.

changes.title: Wand light bonus
changes.text: Prepared hero-attributed Guiding Light bonus damage in wand procs.

changes.title: Magic missile damage
changes.text: Prepared caster-attributed Magic Missile damage scaling.

changes.title: Frost damage
changes.text: Prepared caster-attributed Frost damage while retaining chill and freeze behavior.

changes.title: Lightning damage
changes.text: Prepared caster-attributed Lightning damage including its existing self-hit reduction.

changes.title: Disintegration damage
changes.text: Prepared caster-attributed Disintegration damage while retaining pierce bonuses.

changes.title: Transfusion damage
changes.text: Prepared offensive Transfusion scaling while preserving its unscaled health cost.

changes.title: Ward damage ownership
changes.text: New wards retain their creator identity and use it for their prepared offensive damage path.

changes.title: Real attack regressions
changes.text: Added engine checks for pre-armor scaling, all six starting classes, boss substitution, source preservation and neutral RNG.

changes.title: Real wand regressions
changes.text: Added real missile/frost cast, immunity, resistance, neutral RNG and unchanged Transfusion health-cost checks.

changes.title: Ownership verification evidence
changes.text: Recorded the successful preceding core and Android ownership-foundation checks.

changes.title: Partial damage integration report
changes.text: Recorded integrated attack/wand paths and the remaining spell, delayed-effect and statistics work.

changes.title: Exact build attribution
changes.text: Updated required checks and previous-APK attribution for this integration package.

commentary: I continued the offensive-damage integration with normal attacks and selected wand paths. Damage scaling preserves original defenses and caster identity. These sliders remain pending while the remaining spells and delayed effects are integrated.
